raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Since 2026-01-18 the source sends amount corrections in the daily delivery as a repeat of the txn_id with record_version=2. There are 27 such rows, which matches the 27 duplicate keys (4841 rows vs 4814 distinct txn_id). silver_transactions keeps both versions, so counts and totals in the gold tables are overstated. The fix keeps only the latest record_version per txn_id, applied before the POSTED filter so a later version always supersedes an earlier one.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.88,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) r WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
